flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: App.tsx (compose/message-sent routes commented out), LinkData.tsx (menu commented out), utils/Meta/AdhocNotification.ts (path constants only), ManageTemplate/form (template form, not compose). No ad-hoc code in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi
note: The story asks for a return-to-previous-page option from the preview screen so the officer can change messages, mobile numbers/emails and date/time before sending. Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%), demo_remark empty. The preview screen and ad-hoc compose pages do not exist in main (routes commented out, App.tsx:257-269; menu commented out, LinkData.tsx:143-155), so there is no back option and no form to amend. The template forms (EditTemplateForm, CreateTemplateForm) have Subject and message body, but they save a template with no recipient and no send date/time, so they are not counted. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The preview screen, back option and ad-hoc compose form do not exist in main

steps.step: Officer chooses to go back to the previous page from the preview
steps.detail: No ad-hoc preview screen or back option. The compose-email, compose-sms and message-sent routes are commented out (App.tsx:257-269); AdhocNotification.ts:9-21 are only path constants with no page. Other Back buttons (e.g. in the template form) are not the ad-hoc flow. grep adhoc/ad-hoc, test send, message-sent, compose-sms/compose-email, enotification-send in src of ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi: only commented-out routes/menus (App.tsx:257-269, LinkData.tsx:143-155), path constants (utils/Meta/AdhocNotification.ts), HstAdHocReportService (HST report, not messages) and the 'adhoc' in DataHiveUenFinJob (NRO address, not SMS/email).

steps.step: OCMS returns the officer to the previous page with the entries kept
steps.detail: There is no compose/upload page to return to and no state carried back. The Compose Email, Compose SMS and Message Sent menu entries are commented out (LinkData.tsx:143-155); the Epic37 import is commented out (App.tsx:56) and the pages/epic37 folder does not exist.

steps.step: Officer amends the message, numbers or emails, and send time
steps.detail: No ad-hoc form with recipient number/email and send date/time fields. The template form (CreateTemplateForm.tsx:116-140) only edits the Subject and body of a stored template, with no recipient and no send schedule, so it is not an equivalent of this story. No send date/time field or ad-hoc message scheduler found in the UI or backend.
